generic_name: bismuth subcitrate potassium / metronidazole / tetracycline hydrochloride
revenue_scope: U.S. net sales, fiscal year ended September 30
annual_basis: Aptalis fiscal years 2007 to 2013 (each ended September 30): fiscal 2007-2011 from the net sales sentence in the Pylera section of Aptalis Pharma Inc.'s Forms 10-K for fiscal 2008 through 2011 (fiscal 2007 is the prior-year figure in the fiscal 2008 Form 10-K); fiscal 2012 and 2013 from the U.S. Specialty Pharmaceuticals net product sales table of the Form S-1 filed by the parent, Aptalis Holdings Inc., on 2013-12-26 (Aptalis Pharma Inc. filed no Form 10-K after fiscal 2011). Periods are labelled by the fiscal year, not by calendar year.
moa: Bismuth subcitrate potassium plus metronidazole and tetracycline antibacterial triple combination for H. pylori eradication

approval_evidence.quote: 09/28/2006 ORIG-1 Approval (NDA 050786, PYLERA BISMUTH SUBCITRATE POTASSIUM; METRONIDAZOLE; TETRACYCLINE HYDROCHLORIDE 140MG;125MG;125MG CAPSULE;ORAL; Type 1 - New Molecular Entity and Type 4 - New Combination)

launch_evidence.quote: Since May 7, 2007, we have been marketing as PYLERA a 3-in-1 capsule therapy for the eradication of Helicobacter pylori

series_start_reason: Fiscal 2007 (October 2006 to September 2007) is the launch year (marketing began May 7, 2007) and the earliest year any document prints.
series_end_reason: Fiscal 2013 (ended 2013-09-30) is the last year any Aptalis document prints: the Aptalis Holdings Form S-1 (2013-12-26) was withdrawn on 2014-01-31 (Form RW) after Forest Laboratories agreed to acquire Aptalis. Forest prints only a two-month stub for fiscal 2014 (U.S. .4 million, EU .2 million, Form 10-K filed 2014-05-30, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/38074/000003807414000019/forest10k2014.htm), which is neither a year nor a quarter; Actavis/Allergan plc and AbbVie print no Pylera sales.
notes: U.S. scope: the fiscal 2008 and fiscal 2011 Forms 10-K say 'in the United States'; the fiscal 2011 Form 10-K restates fiscal 2009 (8.2) and fiscal 2010 (10.5) as U.S. net sales, matching the values printed in the fiscal 2009 and fiscal 2010 Forms 10-K. Forest Laboratories' fiscal 2014 Form 10-K says Pylera was launched in Germany in January 2013 and France in April 2013, after the last Aptalis fiscal year in this series. Pylera was sold by AbbVie to Laboratories Juvise Pharmaceuticals in June 2022 (AbbVie Form 10-Q for 2022Q2). Aptalis' fiscal year runs October to September, so the years are not calendar years. Fiscal 2012 (16.7) and 2013 (21.3) are U.S.-only: the S-1 table is the U.S. Specialty Pharmaceuticals segment ('Total U.S. Specialty Pharmaceuticals'), and the S-1 states that International Specialty Pharmaceuticals 'includes all net product sales outside of the United States of SALOFALK, PANZYTRAT and PYLERA' (Pylera launched in Germany January 2013 and France April 2013). The S-1 restates fiscal 2011 as 13.0, equal to the fiscal 2011 Form 10-K. The S-1 carries no interim (quarterly) period. Forest Laboratories' 8-K of 2014-01-27 (exhibit 99.1) also prints fiscal 2013 Pylera net sales as 1 million (rounded).
search_log: Listed all Aptalis Pharma Inc. filings (CIK 0001444570): Forms 10-K for fiscal 2008-2011, Forms 10-Q Dec 2008 through Dec 2011, 8-Ks 2009-2012; searched each 10-K/10-Q for 'pylera' and read every sentence carrying a dollar figure. Only the 10-Ks print Pylera net sales; the 10-Qs and the 2011-01-25 earnings release print no Pylera figure.

Listed Allergan plc filings (CIK 0001578845; every 10-Q/10-K 2013-2020, every item 2.02 8-K 2015-2020): Pylera appears only in risk-factor and patent-litigation prose (Forms 10-K for 2016-2019), never with a sales figure or a table row. AbbVie (CIK 0001551152) 8-Ks and 10-Q/10-K 2020-2026: Pylera appears only as the 2022 divestiture gain ($172 million pre-tax) and Juvise sale note.

Forest Laboratories (CIK 0000038074) Form 10-K for fiscal 2014 (filed 2014-05-21; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/38074/000003807414000019/forest10k2014.htm): 'we recorded sales of Pylera in the U.S. of $2.4 million in fiscal 2014' and 'total EU sales of Pylera of $1.2 million in fiscal 2014' (sales commenced February 2014 after the Aptalis acquisition): a two-month stub, not used.
No quarterly Pylera figure exists in any Aptalis, Forest, Actavis, Allergan or AbbVie document searched.

Re-checked as a quarterly candidate: EDGAR full-text search for 'Pylera' 2001-2014 (63 hits) covering Axcan Pharma Inc. (CIK 0001116094, the pre-2008 owner; 6-K quarterly releases and MD&A for fiscal 2007 and Q1 fiscal 2008, and the 40-F for fiscal 2007), Axcan Intermediate Holdings / Aptalis Pharma Inc. (CIK 0001444570; every 10-Q December 2008 to December 2011 and the 2011-01-25 8-K), Aptalis Holdings Inc. (CIK 0001588172; DRS, DRS/A, S-1, RW), Forest Laboratories (8-Ks and 10-Q/10-K 2014). Axcan's 2007 releases and MD&A name Pylera only for launch costs and amortization; the fiscal 2007 40-F annual information form prints 'sales of PYLERA in the United States have amounted to .8 million for the year ended September 30, 2007' (an annual figure, same as the fiscal 2008 Form 10-K). The 10-Qs name Pylera only in business description, R&D and risk-factor prose. No quarterly or year-to-date Pylera figure exists in any document.

Aptalis Holdings Inc. Form S-1 (0001193125-13-484126): MD&A 'Year Ended September 30' tables print PYLERA 21.3 / 16.7 (2013 / 2012) and 16.7 / 13.0 (2012 / 2011) within Total U.S. Specialty Pharmaceuticals; used for fiscal 2012 and 2013.

no_quarterly_series.source_quote: We reported net sales in the United States of $13.0 million, $10.5 million and $8.2 million for PYLERA in fiscal years 2011, 2010 and 2009, respectively.
no_quarterly_series.details: Aptalis printed Pylera net sales only as fiscal-year figures (Forms 10-K for fiscal 2008-2011; the parent's Form S-1 for fiscal 2012-2013); its Forms 10-Q (December 2008 through December 2011) and the earlier owner Axcan Pharma's 2007 quarterly releases and MD&A mention Pylera without a sales figure, and the later owners (Forest Laboratories, Actavis/Allergan plc, AbbVie) print no Pylera line. No quarterly figure is interpolated.
